pattern.description: Tail of the title-card entrance: the Agentforce 3D wordmark and the 'What is Agentforce?' subtitle finish a small upward drift and slight scale-up, decelerating to rest over the aurora-and-mountains background.
pattern.why_premium: The lockup eases into place instead of stopping dead, so the title feels weighted; the motion is a few pixels and dies out smoothly (energy decays to zero in about 10 frames), giving a clean settle right as the narrator says 'Agentforce'.

build_hint.gsap: gsap.fromTo(['.title-wordmark', '.title-subtitle'], {y: 12, scale: 0.99}, {y: 0, scale: 1, duration: 0.25, ease: 'power3.out', stagger: 0}) as the final settle of the title entrance; wordmark and subtitle move together.
build_hint.remotion: const s = spring({frame: frame - settleStart, fps, config: {damping: 200, stiffness: 180}}); translateY = interpolate(s, [0,1], [12, 0]); scale = interpolate(s, [0,1], [0.99, 1]) - critically damped, no overshoot.

notes: Motion is subtle (whole-frame pan_y -0.068, scale 1.01, camera.move none) and the filmstrip frames are nearly identical; this looks like the decelerating end of a title entrance that began before the burst, or a slow push on the title group. b01 is a broad diff region covering wordmark and subtitle area; b03 (the word 'is') is part of the subtitle and not listed separately. Direction of drift (up) is inferred from pan_y. No SFX candidates.
